description: This file defines the ObservableGrain class, implementing Orleans grain interfaces for observable patterns and incoming call filtering, including methods for streaming data, handling errors, and tracking calls.

classes.name: ObservableGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementing observable streaming and call filtering functionalities, maintaining local call logs and managing updates via channels.

methods.name: GetValues
methods.description: Returns an async stream of string values from the internal channel.

methods.name: GetValuesWithError
methods.description: Generates an async stream of integers, with the ability to throw an error at a specified index.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Signals the end of updates by completing the channel.

methods.name: Fail
methods.description: Completes the channel with an exception to indicate failure.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain by invoking Orleans’ DeactivateOnIdle method.

methods.name: OnNext
methods.description: Writes a string data item asynchronously into the updates channel.

methods.name: GetIncomingCalls
methods.description: Returns a list of stored incoming call interface and method names.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Records the incoming call context details and proceeds with invocation.
